headline: THE RENA TOUR RAN AT 10:30 AND HAS SAID NOTHING SINCE — the first live traffic this house has taken at its list price in eighty-eight days, on the day the agreement expires — and the lake-access answer he asked for twice was sent this morning to the wrong agent, so he still has not been told.

hotSignals.signal: 🔥 THE REPEAT SHOWING RAN AT 10:30 THIS MORNING — Kyle B. of eXp Realty, his SECOND tour, with the ShowingTime notice printing "Showings by this Agent: 2". It is the first provable live traffic this house has taken at $450,000 in eighty-eight days. ⚠️ AND IT HAS PRODUCED SILENCE: no feedback form, no call, nothing from him since 3:47 PM yesterday. ⛔ THE QUESTION HE ASKED TWICE IS STILL UNANSWERED TO HIM — the lake-access answer was researched and sent at 10:00 AM this morning to a different agent who shares his first name at a different brokerage. The content is right and verified against the covenants (lot owners have access at the dam only); it simply reached the wrong inbox. ⏰ It also leaves Gene's own 8/13 3:49 PM promise to "find out" open at roughly twenty-one hours.
hotSignals.action: TEXT HIM — not email, and not later. Send the lake answer and the feedback ask on the same message: what did the buyers think, and is there a number that works. His read is the single input that could still change the repricing decision, and that decision has to be made before the agreement expires at the end of today.

hotSignals.signal: 📞 A SECOND, SEPARATE BUYER SIGNAL ON THE SAME HOUSE THE SAME DAY, AND IT IS STILL UNRETURNED — a buyer phoned directly at 9:33 yesterday morning asking for photos of the workshop and garage. Not an agent, not a form: a person who has studied the listing closely enough to know what is missing from it. ⏰ ROUGHLY TWENTY-TWO HOURS OLD NOW. It sat seven and a half hours because the voicemail arrives from a carrier address the sweep's standing query could not see — a real defect, found and fixed last night rather than buried.
hotSignals.action: Call him back this morning and send the workshop and garage photos. Two independent buyer signals on day 89 of a listing that has produced one offer all summer is the strongest traffic this file has had — and both of them land on the day you have to rule the price.

hotSignals.signal: 🔥 Amber G. of Keller Williams Hoover filed the first validating read in this listing's life off her Monday 8/10 1:40 PM tour: interested — YES · priced right — JUST RIGHT · staging 5 of 5, the highest score this listing has ever recorded. It is the first read filed since the $4,000 cut went live 8/5, and the price objection that had appeared on every prior read is simply gone.
hotSignals.action: ⚠️ AGENT OUTREACH IS HELD, NOT FORGOTTEN — this board is wired to email an interested buyer's agent automatically, and your own 8/7 rule puts co-op agents in the no-email lane. The desk is holding to your rule; the standing question of whether it may DRAFT one for you is on the build board, unruled since 8/8 and now six days old. ⭐ Meanwhile Amber's read is the proof point for the two overdue calls: Cassie C. and Angela B. both called the OLD $299,000 ask too high and neither has ever been told it came down. Call, don't email.

hotSignals.signal: Trecia D. of Century 21 Advantage filed off her Wed 8/12 5:00 PM tour. Interested: No. Priced right: BLANK. Price recommendation: BLANK. Verbatim: "The kitchen is nice and floors as well, but the stairs are too much. Nice home though." ⭐ NOT A SOLID HIT — it is a pass — but it is recorded because it is the FOURTH consecutive read since the cut that declined to argue the number. Seven reads on this listing, and every single price-recommendation field has come back blank.
hotSignals.action: No outreach — interested = No, so this falls outside the interested-feedback rule entirely. Use it as evidence in the two overdue agent calls: the objection on this house is layout, never price.

hotSignals.signal: Wanda W. of Millennium Homes answered the interest question on her Sat 8/8 12:50 PM showing with the single word "Very" — and left every other field on the form blank. The enthusiasm is on the record and the reason is not, which is exactly what makes it a phone call rather than a form reminder.
hotSignals.action: Call her — now six days unworked. Ask what her buyer liked and whether size is a problem, because the other two reads that same Saturday both said the house is too small.

upcoming: ✅ RAN — Fri 8/14 10:30–11:00 AM — 198 RENA DRIVE, Springville. Kyle B., eXp Realty — his SECOND showing on this house, and the first provable live traffic at $450,000 in eighty-eight days. ⏰ NO FEEDBACK FILED and nothing from him since 3:47 PM yesterday. ⛔ THE OWED ITEM WENT TO THE WRONG PERSON — the lake-access answer was researched and emailed at 10:00 AM to a different agent with the same first name at a different brokerage. He asked by text, twice; he still has not been told. ⭐ Text him the answer and the feedback ask together — his read is the one input that could still change tonight's pricing decision, and the agreement expires at the end of today.

📅 5167 LAKE CREST CIRCLE — closing THURSDAY 8/20 at 3:00 PM at the closing attorney's office. ✅ WORTH NAMING TODAY OF ALL DAYS: this board printed 8/14 for a day, and 8/14 is now. That field was stale and was corrected off two receipts — a live calendar event and an executed addendum — before it could fire a closing celebration six days early on a file still at appraisal. The appraisal is complete and clean and the repair addendum is fully executed.

📅 195 LAKE VIEW CIRCLE — close receipted 8/28. Both gates already cleared: inspection 8/5 at noon, appraisal 8/7 at 9:00 AM, both on primary notices. ⚠️ The appraised value itself still has not come back — DAY EIGHT. ⚠️ And the seller has now been waiting three days on a returned call.
📅 3350 ALTAMONT ROAD E21 — closing 9/14. ✅ Inspection held 8/13 at 10:00 AM; MLS reads CONTINGENT. ✅ Contract out with all signatures, packet received by the closing attorney.

✅ DONE — Thu 8/13 11:15 AM — 1709 FIELDSTONE CIRCLE, Helena. Buyer's inspection on the $390,000 contract, COMPLETED at 12:53 PM. ⏰ STILL NO REPAIR REQUEST — the buyers' response window is into its second day and that document is the next real event on the file. The buyers also still have unanswered questions and the offered phone call has not connected.

⚠️ AND THAT IS THE ENTIRE CONFIRMED CALENDAR. This morning's Rena tour has now run, and scheduled buyer traffic across the whole portfolio from here forward — including the weekend — is ZERO. That is the quiet number on this page, and the reason the two overdue Comanche agent calls keep rising to the top: they are the only at-bats on the board that do not require a new buyer to appear.

listings.status: 🔥 ACTIVE — the second showing RAN at 10:30 and said nothing, and the agreement expires tonight

feedback.note: Answered the chase by text at 8:07 AM rather than through the form: "We have to get their house on the market befofe we look anymore." ⭐ A CONTINGENCY ANSWER, NOT A PRICE ANSWER — zero property feedback, no number named. Then at 1:57 PM the same agent requested a second showing, confirmed at 3:41, and at 3:47 asked where the lake access is. 🔴 AND HE RETRACTED SOMETHING IMPORTANT: the 8/11 full-price tour NEVER HAPPENED — "didn't have time to see yours." The strongest argument this board carried against repricing was never real.

A buyer called at 9:33 AM asking for photos of the workshop and garage. Sat seven and a half hours — the voicemail arrives from a carrier address the sweep's query could not see — and is still unreturned this morning at roughly twenty-two hours.
Interested: No. Every price field left BLANK. The stated objections were the upstairs bathroom and a compartmentalized interior — floor plan, not price.

gaps: 🔴 Fri 8/14 10:30 AM — the tour RAN and no feedback has been filed. Newest gap on the board, and the most expensive one: it is the only read that could still inform tonight's pricing decision.
⚠️ Sun 8/9 4:30 PM — booked, confirmed, then CANCELLED the same afternoon.
🔴 Tue 8/11 2:15 PM — confirmed, and it NEVER TOOK PLACE. The agent said so himself two days later. This board treated it as a full-price showing for two days.
listings.note: ⏰ DAY 89, no price change since May, and the agreement expires at the end of TODAY with the number still unruled. ⭐ The extension is ruled and must not be re-asked — only the number is open. ⭐ Eighty-nine days at this price produced exactly one written offer, and the co-op agent volunteered that figure as their client's ceiling. 🔴 THE COUNTER-EVIDENCE COLLAPSED ON 8/13 — the 8/11 tour that argued against a cut never happened, by the agent's own admission. 🆕 THIS MORNING'S TOUR IS THE NEWEST FACT AND IT CUTS THE SAME WAY: it ran, and it generated nothing. A showing that produces silence is not an argument for holding. ⛔ THE ONE THING STILL OWED IS A TEXT — the lake answer reached the wrong Kyle at 10:00 AM. 🔥 A direct buyer asking for workshop and garage photos is also still unreturned at twenty-seven hours. ⚠️ Quote $450,000 only until the sellers rule.

feedback.note: Off the Wed 8/12 5:00 PM tour. Interested: No. Priced right and price recommendation both BLANK. Verbatim: "The kitchen is nice and floors as well, but the stairs are too much. Nice home though." A layout objection.

listings.status: ✅ UNDER CONTRACT — both gates cleared, close 8/28, and the seller is waiting on a call
listings.note: ✅ The cleanest file on the board on paper — both gates spent on primary notices. 🔴 AND YET THE SELLER HAS BEEN WAITING SINCE TUESDAY ON A RETURNED VOICEMAIL — three days, mid-transaction, on the deal with the least to worry about. That is the row on this file that actually needs a call today. ⚠️ The payoff got WEAKER, not firmer: your transaction manager reported Wednesday that he "had forgotten" about ordering it. Ordered is not received-by-title, and forgotten is not ordered. ⚠️ The appraised value still has not come back at DAY EIGHT — a quiet appraisal is usually just a quiet appraisal, but eight days earns a call to the lender. ⚠️ An address-correction addendum left unsigned on 8/4 should be confirmed closed. ⚠️ A co-op commission ask from the buyer's agent has never been answered.

✅ TODAY IS THE DATE THIS BOARD WRONGLY PRINTED FOR A DAY, AND NOTHING IS FIRING — which is the correction working. The board had said "close receipted 8/14, nothing seen since 8/4." The DATE was the error, not the deal: the milestone engine corrected it off two receipts — a live calendar event naming the closing attorney, the buyers and the buyer's agent, and an executed addendum from 8/12 identifying this exact field as the stale figure being carried forward. ⭐ Had it stood, this morning's run would have fired a closing celebration and a referral script six days early on a file still at appraisal. ⭐ Appraisal complete and clean on the lender's own words; repair addendum fully executed; septic inspection ran 8/4. ⛔ 8/14 is retired — do not re-print it.

listings.status: 🔥 ACTIVE — the only ad producing anything, and the perc answer is blocked behind a county fee
listings.note: 🆕 FOUR BUYER SIGNALS IN THREE DAYS while every other ad in the portfolio produced zero. 🔴 THE BUILDER'S SEPTIC-PERC QUESTION IS NOW FOUR DAYS OLD AND STILL BLOCKED: your transaction manager spent five and a half hours on it and reports the county will not search the records without a per-lot fee across all nineteen lots. She is stopped until you rule, and she has been stopped overnight. ⭐ TRY THE FREE PATH FIRST — ask the developer, who almost certainly holds the perc results from platting. ⚠️ That question is the gate on the whole package: perc decides buildability, buildability decides price per lot, and a builder who gets no answer assumes the worst. ⚠️ Two builder outreach addresses are BOUNCING, found in this morning's inbox triage — part of the builder audience for this package is receiving nothing at all. ⭐ Blocks and takedowns at a higher per-lot number remain acceptable per the seller's own ruling.

Booking against an unsigned agreement is exactly how a shoot slips — and this same sequence already cost time on the Deer Ridge file. ⭐ Close the signature and confirm the shoot in the same call, today. ⚠️ The state tracker has carried this at ACTIVE since 6/19 while the sellers are only now asking for photos — it was seeded to the wrong stage; treat it as pre-launch.

She left a twenty-two-second voicemail on 7/25 rather than sending a seventh text — then on Wednesday night escalated THREE TIMES IN TWENTY-SEVEN MINUTES: two voicemails and a text. ⚠️ You do not need an answer to make this call, and waiting for one is exactly what turned six days into twenty. ⚠️ A reply to her paint question was staged as a draft Wednesday and is still unsent.

oweFeedback.when: 🔴 THREE ASKS AND TWENTY-FOUR DAYS OF SILENCE — Tue 7/21, Wed 7/22 and Thu 7/23, from the RealtySouth Inverness listing side after your 7/21 1:00 PM tour. ⭐ THIS IS THE ONE THAT COSTS SOMETHING REAL, and the cost is not the courtesy — it is that the honest written answer IS your counter on the largest number on your board, roughly $36K of GCI. The listing side has asked repeatedly to be moved forward; a seller who reverse-offers a buyer is a seller who wants a deal. Twenty minutes of writing moves it. ⚠️ The appraisal figure your buyer cited as far under ask is single-sourced from him — do not quote it to the other side as an appraised value.

⏰ TWO FEEDBACK REQUESTS, 7/31 and 8/1, from the Keller Williams Hoover listing side. The listing has since gone from CONTINGENT to EXPIRED between the two notices, so the ask is stale — but a one-line courtesy reply still costs nothing and this is a Lake Crest-subdivision agent you will meet again.
